# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PROJECTS DATA - single source of truth for the /projects/ page.
# Add, remove, or edit projects here and the site picks them up
# automatically (no template changes required).
#
# This file is data-only - it has no rendered body. The /projects/
# page is generated by projects/index.html, which reads this file's
# frontmatter via `site.pages`.
#
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SCHEMA per project (only `name` and `description` are required):
#
#   name:         "Display name"
#   id:           "slug-style-id"               → uppercase ID label
#                                                  AND filename of the
#                                                  screenshot (see below)
#   status:       ok | wip | alpha | priv       → coloured status badge
#                   ok    → RELEASE  (green)
#                   wip   → UPCOMING (amber)
#                   alpha → ALPHA    (purple)
#                   priv  → RESEARCH (grey)
#   year:         2025
#   description:  "One short paragraph."
#   features:     ["bullet 1", "bullet 2"]      → 2-col grid with red ›
#   stack:        ["Rust", "Python"]            → small mono chips
#   tags:         ["red-team", "research"]      → footer #tag row
#   links:
#     github:     "https://..."                 → opens in new tab from modal
#     demo:       "https://..."
#     paper:      "https://..."
#   featured:     true                          → also surfaces on /home
#
# CLICK BEHAVIOUR
#   Clicking a card opens a preview modal showing the screenshot,
#   description, stack, tags, and link buttons. To attach a screenshot,
#   drop a PNG at:
#
#       /assets/img/projects/{id}.png
#
#   matching the project's `id`. If the file is missing, the modal
#   shows a "NO PREVIEW AVAILABLE" tag in place of the image.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Hide this raw data file from the sitemap - it's data, not a real page.
sitemap: false
